note: The printed form is the reader's own syntax, with each element printed as %S prints it: Emacs gives the string "[1 (2) \"x\"]" and so does kg. This is the re-readable-printing half of 24.1 stated as a value rather than as a round trip, because kg has neither `read-from-string' nor `prin1-to-string' at this pin and a round-trip case would pin a different frontier than the one this phase closes. Carries "expect": "agree" inside the vector-printing row, whose other two cases are the self-referential ones fe deliberately still diverges on.
